mechanism: Rifampin is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer that increases metabolism and clearance of tranylcypromine, reducing its MAOI efficacy and increasing risk of hypertensive crisis if dosing is adjusted upward to compensate.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, monitor blood pressure closely and consider alternative antitubercular agent; tranylcypromine dose adjustment may be required but increases unpredictability of response.
